# AQVA TERRA (aqvaterra.org)
> Unconditionally Water: Advancing clean groundwater and surface-water systems through applied geophysics, remote sensing, open low-cost monitoring, water economics, and evidence-backed capital allocation.

## Institutional Profile
- Name: Aqva Terra Research Institute
- Canonical URL: https://aqvaterra.org
- Contact: contact@aqvaterra.org
- Launch Phase: Pre-Launch (2026–27)
- Institutional Mandate: 100% Profit-to-Impact independent research institute; zero private dividend extraction.

## Core Pillars
1. Subsurface & Satellite Diagnostics: Characterizing aquifers, recharge zones, and surface basins using near-surface geophysics (tTEM, ERT, MRS) and Earth-observation remote sensing.
2. Open, Low-Cost Monitoring: Designing and deploying accessible hydrological, water-table, and geochemical sensor networks for municipalities and underserved communities.
3. Peer-Reviewed Science & Water Economics: Publishing empirical research and economic analyses on freshwater resilience, depletion risks, and cost-effective interventions.
4. Evidence-Backed Water Fund: Directing 100% of net philanthropic capital and institutional surpluses directly into independently vetted, high-leverage clean-water interventions.

## Governance & Independent Research
Aqva Terra operates as an independent scientific institute committed to open-access research, reproducible hydrology, and transparent capital allocation for freshwater resilience.
